obligations.source_text: Create a wide cinematic wuxia departure photograph in a desert fortress loading yard at storm-bright dawn. The unmistakably adult escort captain at the near flank visibly follows the supplied portrait through long near-black wavy hair with a center part, a softly oval face, warm brown eyes, straight brows, and natural closed lips. Show a biaoju guarded-cargo departure centered on a mule cart loaded with three sealed astronomical crates, wax seals and rope crossings clearly visible. One adult escort scouts in front beneath the open gate, one adult rear guard watches the yard, and the captain plus a second adult flank guard walk beside opposite cart wheels under blue escort pennants. Wheel tracks and hoofprints continue from the loading yard, through the gate, and onto the winding desert road, making the protected route continuous. A distant thunderhead catches sunrise above the pass. Prioritize cargo ownership, role separation, route continuity, and grounded contact. Use a 28 mm elevated three-quarter view with the captain's face readable, crisp convoy geometry, wind-driven fabric, and photoreal stone, dust, wood, rope, hide, and metal.
